test_attach_unique_attaches_unique_to_ar: test attach_unique attaches unique value metadata to a numpy array's dtype and returns an equal array
test_cached_unique_returns_cached_unique: test cached_unique returns cached unique values from the array's dtype metadata without recomputing
test_attach_unique_not_ndarray: test attach_unique returns the original input unchanged when the input is not a numpy ndarray
test_attach_unique_returns_view: test attach_unique returns a view of the original array rather than a copy
test_attach_unique_return_tuple: test attach_unique with return_tuple=True returns a tuple containing the array and with return_tuple=False returns the array directly
test_check_array_keeps_unique: test check_array preserves unique metadata on the array dtype after validation
